title: http.bzl http_archive downloads multiple times if build_file is specified

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
### Description of the problem:
If you override the native rule for http_archive by loading http.bzl, and provide a build_file argument to http_archive, bazel downloads the file 3 times. If build_file_content is provided as empty or neither build_file_content or build_file are provided, it downloads 1 time as expected.

I was trying to write my own repository rule based on http.bzl and found that my rule was downloading external dependencies multiple times.

### reproduce the problem:
There's a test repository at https://github.com/jemdiggity/test_bazel_external_dependencies.git

WORKSPACE:
```python
load(
    "@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl",
    "http_archive",
)

http_archive(
  name = "test_1M",
  build_file = "//:test.BUILD",
  urls = ["http://127.0.0.1:8000/random_1M.tar.gz"],
  sha256 = "45939342315aaefed2215e21fe2c2280e0a06346b33304e9dbd241c5eb4a31cb",
)
```

test.sh:
```shell
python -m SimpleHTTPServer &

bazel clean --expunge
bazel fetch @test_1M//...
```

output:
```
INFO: Starting clean (this may take a while). Consider using --expunge_async if the clean takes more than several minutes.
...........................................Serving HTTP on 0.0.0.0 port 8000 ...
....................
127.0.0.1 - - [18/Mar/2017 12:08:20] "GET /random_1M.tar.gz HTTP/1.1" 200 -
127.0.0.1 - - [18/Mar/2017 12:08:20] "GET /random_1M.tar.gz HTTP/1.1" 200 -
127.0.0.1 - - [18/Mar/2017 12:08:20] "GET /random_1M.tar.gz HTTP/1.1" 200 -
WARNING: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_jeremyhale/85a0eef1523b5b3d420a647e3e90da76/external/bazel_tools/tools/build_defs/repo/http.bzl:42:5: ctx.attr.build_file //:test.BUILD.
INFO: All external dependencies fetched successfully.
```
